summary: Data professional with over 3 years of experience combining Data Engineering and Software Development. I work on modernizing data architectures with Microsoft Fabric, PySpark and Azure Data Lake, building ETL/ELT pipelines and designing dimensional models (Star Schema, Medallion architecture) for Lakehouses. Proficient in Python, SQL and Power BI (advanced DAX), with a solid Full Stack development background (Java, Spring Boot, Angular) built on a government project. Focused on process automation, data governance (LGPD) and delivering strategic business metrics.

bullets: Optimized data engineering pipelines in Pentaho Data Integration and Python routines for analytical consumption of SAP ECC ERP APIs, cutting heavy-load processing time from 4 hours to 1 hour.

Architected modern Lakehouses in Microsoft Fabric and Azure Synapse following the Medallion architecture and Star Schema modeling, integrating heterogeneous sources (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL and APIs) into OneLake to centralize fact and dimension tables.

Automated the ingestion and processing of analytical reports from the SULTS platform directly into Power BI, eliminating 100% of weekly manual export processes and increasing decision-making agility by 40%.
Built sales-performance management dashboards with advanced DAX and complex modeling in Power BI, delivering real-time visibility into future receivables, net portfolio and commission rules.
Managed technical requirements and the governance of analytics demands via Jira and Agidesk, reducing overdue tickets and the work-order reopen rate by 50%.
Established data governance guidelines aligned with LGPD, designing DataOps flows, Data Quality criteria and the formal appointment of Data Owners.

Developed Python scripts to automate the migration and processing of data from the legacy Rhevolution ecosystem to the LG platform (Gente 360° project), processing over 136k exam rows and 20k medical certificate records.

Implemented an automation flow between Microsoft Forms and Microsoft Lists via Power Automate for the Psychosocial Assessment (NR1 compliance), eliminating manual handling and applying business rules with score-based visual alerts.
Created the “BI Ações” analytics dashboard in Power BI to consolidate internal campaigns, cutting information-gathering time by over 70% and generating automated productivity insights.

Systematized financial monitoring of operating expenses in the “BI Custo Fixo” data model, centralizing the history in Power BI to support investment decisions and the early identification of bottlenecks.

Customized and deployed the DSpace digital repository platform from scratch in PGFN’s corporate environment, delivering the complete ecosystem in 8 months (versus 1.5 years estimated by external consultancies) and generating direct savings of R$ 1 million in public funds.
Architected backend components in Java, Spring Boot, Maven and Apache Tomcat integrated with PostgreSQL and Apache Solr indexing, enabling automated metadata extraction from PDF files.
Developed a unified web interface in Angular, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and HTML, with advanced taxonomy search and parameterized metadata filtering.
Cut the teams’ operational time by 85% in the manual transfer of legal opinion data into spreadsheets, streamlining document management.
Containerized the application with Docker and deployed it on Linux servers; managed version control in GitLab and wrote the technical documentation of the customizations.

Managed social media and produced graphic and audiovisual content (Canva, Photoshop, Adobe Premiere Pro); supported the CEO with issuing invoices and customer service, strengthening the brand’s reputation.
